description: A condition path outside the closed grammar floors the entry that carries it, and only that entry: the fact it was stating is the one that would have made the callee clean, so it cannot be read past.

diagnostics.message: Call to `eachItem` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is claimed by a carrier entry this release cannot use — a shape outside the manifest schema, or a condition path with no form in this engine — so the fact that would have colored it is not applied. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@nothrow/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
